links.comparator_used: Previously commissioned results for the same cases in RayStation 11B (version-to-version paired comparison), not a go-live-only validation arm
links.outcome: Detection of segmentation performance shifts (DSC, MSD, HD95) after a software upgrade
links.effect: Re-running the fixed commissioned case sets in 2024A gave mean DSC 0.81 ± 0.09 (head and neck), 0.84 ± 0.13 (thorax) and 0.89 ± 0.06 (male pelvis). Significant paired differences between versions (p < 0.05) were limited to selected structures: mandible, cochlea and eye; lungs and esophagus; prostate.
links.quote: Significant paired differences between versions were limited to selected structures, including the mandible, cochlea, and eye in head and neck; lungs and esophagus in thorax; and prostate in the male pelvis (p < 0.05).

design_hint: local commissioning and regression testing after software upgrade
